title: SIMULATION CHAMBERS
subtitle: Bounded scenario explorations — every step is SIMULATED and quarantined from observed reality
quarantineBody: Everything an engram produces inside a chamber is tagged SIMULATED and written to the world model as
quarantineBodyEnd: provenance only. It is never promoted to observed reality, and no engine path can merge it into the engram's base state.
emptyBody: When a simulation-capable engram enters a chamber, it can propose a scenario and run it in bounded steps. Proposed runs wait for you to start them.
directBody: Give an engram a specific scenario to explore. They must be present in the simulation chamber; every beat stays quarantined as SIMULATED.
autoPremise: Let the engram generate the premise
autoPremisePlaceholder: The engram will generate a scenario from its drives and world context…
premisePlaceholder: Scenario premise — e.g. 'You wake in a mirrored version of your basement where every screen shows a different year…'
noCapableEngrams: No simulation-capable engrams are available. Enable simulation and use simulation or full-bounded mode.
openedDescription: The first beat is being generated now.
